processId.description: The definition this run was started from

title.description: The run's name; the engine keeps it equal to props.title

activities.description: Each activity's state, keyed by activity ID

aggregatePassFail.description: Set when a run completes: any_fail if any activity failed, all_pass if at least one passed and none failed

position.description: The child's index in its parent sequence

ActivityRun.description: An activity's definition (copied in when the run starts) plus its state

status.description: running: under way, or waiting (a human activity for a person, a receive activity for another system); timeout: a receive activity's wait ran out

passFail.description: The result of the activity's passWhen

fields.description: The activity's values (acts.<id> in code): a human activity's form fields; a receive activity's fields with the values received, plus any its code returned; or the object a compute or api activity's code returned

expressionValue.description: switch: the value the expression or condition produced

matchedCase.description: switch: the case taken (then, else, a case key, or default)

nextActivity.description: switch: the activity it routed to

responseData.description: api: the HTTP result (status, headers, data)

FieldValue.description: A field with the value the run holds for it

value.description: For a file field, a file reference (metadata, url, thumbnailUrl)
